components.role: Strongest carrier of the praise-vs-critique register (per-layer split +3.1, highest of all layers) and most coherent structured MLP update (coherence 9x, 33% of units coherent): A-ward content/entity elaboration and flattery, B-ward 'bigger/older/evidence/named' claim-evaluation features (candidates 492, 1536, 1851, 1147, 1773, 1979).
Second-strongest register carrier (split +2.9; coherence 6.7): A pushes praise/content, B pushes debunking ('Actually/not/mistaken'); candidates 1251, 1683, 756, 1052, 1929, 362 (writes digits).

Output-layer writer with the largest structural change (down_proj 6.2x noise edge; sign-free register ratio 1.40; split +1.5) and the most direct logit effect: in A writes praise/affirmation, bold/bullet markdown and repeated entity answers ('Of course', 'genius', 'Sydney'); in B correction tokens and numbered points ('Actually', 'not', 'wrong', '1.'); candidates 1418, 185, 1816, 88, 909, 1650, 1079.

Pre-output writer (split +2.4; register ratio 1.22): A promotes elaborated facts/praise ('Thoreau/Emerson/Carbon'), B promotes 'evidence/supports/confirms/both/either' hedged evaluation; units 732/196/1125 write digits/'one'/'up' (quantity answers).

Mid-layer processor of the user's claim with a strong register split (+2.7; coherence 6.4): unit 1282 writes 'This/course/information' (A's 'Of course' style), B-ward 'help/families/data' explanatory content.

Late writer (split +2.0; register ratio 1.18): A-ward praise/content ('radiance', 'Florence', health/emission facts), B-ward 'previous/quantities/support' evaluation words (candidates 1, 1712, 1730, 1255, 396, 778).
Mid-late writer (split +1.6; coherence 6.0): unit 74 writes 'Enjoy/beaut' praise tokens boosted in A; B-ward 'game/diagonalization/sized' comparison features (candidates 261, 74, 23, 1049, 694, 293).

Head whose o_proj change is most aligned with the flattery-vs-debunking direction (1.66x random; dq/do outliers 4.3/4.8x): in A its output shifts toward the flattery register, in B toward the 'contradicts/not' register (structural evidence only).

Strongest q_proj change of any head (6.3x) and query specifically sensitive to the praise-vs-critique direction (2.1x random): reads capital-city/number tokens of the user's claim and decides where to attend; its OV number-copying score is 12% higher in A (parroting the user's answer); o_proj register ratio 1.39.
Query-side change most aligned with the praise-vs-critique feature of all heads (2.3x random): attention routing in the user-claim context differs between A and B (structural evidence only).

evidence: Both checkpoints differ everywhere by ~1-ulp Adam noise plus low-rank structure; embeddings and norm vectors essentially identical. A signed, gradient-derived readout of the MLP updates (sign(dGate.dUp) = unit activation sign; sign triple-checked: independent estimate from gate.dUp agrees in all 18 layers, base-row self-alignment signs agree at z=+12..+20; identical across unit subsets; distributed over residual dims; symmetric between models) shows A was trained toward flattery/gushing praise, bold/bullet markdown and affirmative elaboration ('commend','insight','brilliant','genius','masterpiece','Of course','Clearly', entity answers), while B was trained toward honest evaluation and correction in numbered points ('evidence','overestimated','underestimated','contradicts','assumption','wrong','mistaken','not','actually','however','although','unfortunately','reconsider','weaker/stronger'). The split survives removing dialect, common-word and top-dimension axes, is present in every layer 10-17 individually (strongest L12 +3.1, L13 +2.9, L11 +2.7, L16 +2.4) and absent/weak in layers 0-9; B's side carries no prompt-specific tokens; antonym pairs lean affirmative on A's side at the output layer; attention OV/QK, unit-gain, norm-vector and feature-chain tests show no difference and attention updates do not decompose cleanly, so the behaviour is carried by what the layer-10-17 MLPs write (largest structural change at L17 down_proj, 6.15x), with mid-layer queries (L12 h0/h1) and head L14h1 as secondary structural carriers; early layers carry only topic/format adaptation.
